ideas.pitch: A localized environmental monitoring and forecasting dashboard that uses satellite data and Poisson regression to predict carbon credit generation and soil health degradation risks across Virginia forestlands.
ideas.title: Appalachian Forest Carbon Sequestration Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines rigorous statistical modeling with regional environmental relevance, mirroring the technical depth of the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent student and researcher support platform powered by LangGraph and RAG that indexes campus department publications to automatically synthesize grant opportunities and lab collaboration matches.
ideas.title: HokieCampus Autonomous Research Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the immediate utility desired by university-affiliated judges by solving localized academic information silos.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered risk detection and investigation platform tailored for regional agricultural supply chains, combining graph intelligence and LightGBM to trace food fraud and financial anomalies.
ideas.title: LocalAgri Supply Chain Risk & AML Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering via graph intelligence and financial-grade risk modeling, echoing the winning pattern of the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient acquisition and trust engine using the Gemini API to streamline intake documentation and trust verification for rural healthcare clinics in Virginia.
ideas.title: MedTrust Virginia Patient Intake Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers immediate, tangible workflow automation for an underserved industry vertical, matching the execution speed and polish of the Prize Hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace featuring USDC escrow payments on Base, allowing student developers to buy and sell specialized micro-services and compute tasks autonomously.
ideas.title: VailChain Autonomous Agent Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages cutting-edge decentralized execution and smart contract escrow patterns proven successful at the Synthesis Hackathon.
